//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the RANGE-GROUP compact control — the `.pa-range-group` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.RangeGroup.range_group/1`, svelte `forms/RangeGroup.svelte`). SCOPE = the GROUP CONTAINER SHELL ONLY (root + toggle[summary+caret] + floating panel + Reset/Apply actions footer). WHY container-only (splitter precedent): the group is a COMPOSITE — its panel holds one `.pa-range` SLIDER PRIMITIVE per dimension, built from a child input the generic single-component dumpers CANNOT feed (keen a required `:range` SLOT, svelte a required `rows: RangeGroupRow[]` ARRAY — the map `kind`s are enum/string/bool/slot/const, none can carry an array of row configs). So the dumpers render the group with ZERO rows, and the GOLDEN asserts only the always-emitted shell the snippet/demo bless (closed state, no `--open`). The `.pa-range` slider primitive is a SEPARATE block/component (keen `range/1`, core renders it per-row) and is therefore OUT OF SCOPE here — NOT in `blocks` — so this fixture is `blocks: [pa-range-group]` only; every `pa-range` / `pa-range__*` / `pa-range--*` class (rail/track/fill/thumb, handle-shape + single + disabled + ticks-labeled modifiers) is the child-composition sub-slice, prose-deferred below. SVELTE IS NOT DUMPABLE by the generic harness: `RangeGroup.svelte` calls `onDestroy()` (debounce cleanup) at init, and the dumper's standalone `render()` has no component lifecycle context, so `onDestroy` throws `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'r')` — the SAME dump.mjs lifecycle-context limitation documented for setContext components (splitter.svelte). Verified by running the dumper (per task, dump.mjs must NOT be edited). So there is NO svelte dump/compare; the svelte map is still authored + validated by capability axis-2 (capability-only). KEEN dumps + compares cleanly (keen `range_group/1` has NO init-time lifecycle call). Canonical shape: packages/core/snippets/range-group.html (the closed `.pa-range-group` + the `--open` resulting-DOM reference).

svelte.exempt: not dumpable by the generic harness — RangeGroup.svelte calls onDestroy() at init (lifecycle_outside_component under the standalone SSR render); svelte map validated via capability axis-2 only, keen strict-compares (see note above)

propsVocabulary.groupId: DOM id on the group root. API DIVERGENCE: keen `id` is REQUIRED (the LiveView hook anchor — keen also wires phx-hook="PureAdminRangeGroup" off it, normalized away by the comparator); svelte `RangeGroup` has NO id prop at all (it keys the hook off the display:contents host). Set in every keen golden because keen needs it; mapped in BOTH maps for axis-2 completeness (the svelte side is a declared-but-unused divergence, like splitter's splitterId). Structural attr, no class.
propsVocabulary.ariaLabel: aria-label on the floating panel dialog (keen `panel_aria_label`, svelte `ariaLabel`; both default "Numeric filters"). Structural attr, no class. NB svelte ALSO stamps aria-label on the toggle button (keen does not) — an acknowledged divergence, moot for the golden since svelte is non-dumpable.
propsVocabulary.resetText: Reset button label (keen `reset_text`, svelte hard-codes "Reset"). Text content, no class.
propsVocabulary.applyText: Apply button label (keen `apply_text`, svelte hard-codes "Apply"). Text content, no class.
propsVocabulary.hasActions: render the Reset / Apply footer (keen `has_actions`, default true; svelte always renders it). false → the pa-range-group__actions block is omitted entirely.
propsVocabulary.panelStyle: inline style on the __panel — where per-instance --pa-range-* token overrides belong (the panel reparents to <body> when open). keen `panel_style`, svelte `panelStyle`. GUARD: a nil value must emit NO style attribute (not a phantom style=""). Structural, no class. Declared-but-not-exercised (no golden sets it) — see goldenConventions.
propsVocabulary.body: the panel's rows — one .pa-range-group__row (+ .pa-range slider) per dimension. In this container-only slice it is EMPTY (the dumpers can't build the rows from a slot/array). keen `:range` slot, svelte `rows` prop. The per-row structure is the prose-deferred child-composition sub-slice.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim on the root (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature.

goldenConventions: Goldens assert the always-emitted CLOSED shell: <div id="..." class="pa-range-group" data-range-group> > a __toggle button (aria-expanded="false") wrapping an empty __summary span + a __caret span, then the __panel (role=dialog, aria-label) whose only child is the __actions footer (Reset / Apply) — the panel holds ZERO .pa-range-group__row because the generic dumpers can't feed the rows. This is the snippet's closed-state shape minus the JS-built rows/segments. The bare marker attrs (data-range-group, data-range-group-toggle, data-range-group-summary, data-range-group-panel, data-range-output, data-range-group-reset/-apply) are NOT in the normalizer's BOOLEAN_ATTRS set, so presence + spelling must match; both the golden and keen emit them bare. phx-* (keen's hook wiring) is stripped by the normalizer; the hand-set `id` is SIGNAL and is written in every golden (keen requires it). panelStyle is deliberately NOT set in any golden: it is the style-attr GUARD prop — keen's fix folds it into the panel attrs only when present so nil emits no attribute (a bare style={nil} renders style="" in HEEx, the desc-table/loader/gauge phantom-style bug); mapped in both maps for axis-2. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability. COMPARE: svelte has NO compare run (non-dumpable — onDestroy at init, see top note); keen compares clean on every scenario.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-range-group(--|__)'). The ONLY pa-range-group BLOCK modifier is --open (JS-toggled on the root when the panel opens -> cssStateClasses). Group-level props here are all structural (produces:null) — the group shell carries fixed element classes, not prop-driven modifiers. The JS-built summary segments (__seg-*), the --open panel/row-value state, and the per-row __row* elements are NOT in the SSR shell: __seg-* + __panel--open + __row-value--empty are cssStateElements (built/toggled by range-group.js at runtime), and __row / __row-head / __row-label / __row-value are the per-row child-composition sub-slice (deferred). The .pa-range slider primitive is a separate block, out of scope entirely (see top note).

groupId.note: structural — DOM id on the root. keen `id` REQUIRED (hook anchor + phx-hook off it, phx-* normalized away); svelte has no id prop (declared-but-unused in the svelte map). Set in every golden; mapped in both maps for axis-2.

ariaLabel.note: structural — aria-label on the __panel dialog (default "Numeric filters").

resetText.note: structural — Reset button text (svelte hard-codes it; keen `reset_text`).

applyText.note: structural — Apply button text (svelte hard-codes it; keen `apply_text`).

hasActions.note: structural — presence of the __actions footer. false omits it. svelte always renders it (declared-but-unused in the svelte map).

panelStyle.note: structural — inline style on the __panel; nil MUST emit no style attribute (keen folds it into the panel attrs only when present). Declared-but-not-exercised; mapped in both maps for axis-2.

body.note: structural — the panel rows. EMPTY in this container-only slice; the per-row .pa-range-group__row + .pa-range is the deferred child-composition sub-slice.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim after pa-range-group, not a core feature.

deferred.//: Per-ROW element classes of the pa-range-group block — NOT the group shell. Both wrappers build one __row per dimension from a child input the generic single-component dumper can't supply (keen a required `:range` slot, svelte a required `rows` array). PROSE deferral (not a verified {fixture:...} ref): neither dumper registers a `range` fragment this session and the dumpers must not be edited, so a `{fixture:...}` ref would hard-fail DEFER?. Verified instead in each wrapper's own component tests. The .pa-range SLIDER PRIMITIVE block (pa-range / pa-range__* / pa-range--*) is a SEPARATE component, entirely out of scope (not in `blocks`), so its classes are not this fixture's responsibility.
deferred.pa-range-group__row: per-row — one dimension; built from the rows slot/array the container dumper can't feed
deferred.pa-range-group__row-head: per-row — the row's label + readout header
deferred.pa-range-group__row-value: per-row — [data-range-output] live readout (JS fills the text)

cssStateClasses.//: pa-range-group-- BLOCK modifier range-group.js TOGGLES at runtime (never hand-authored at SSR), so no feature produces it; the axis-1 block-modifier reverse check counts it as claimed.
cssStateClasses.pa-range-group--open: Added to the root while the panel is open (rotates the __caret 180deg). Toggled by range-group.js on open/close — never part of the SSR markup.

cssStateElements.//: pa-range-group__ ELEMENT classes range-group.js BUILDS or TOGGLES at runtime and that never appear in the SSR shell a wrapper emits — no feature can produce them and no SSR golden can exercise them. The __summary span IS in the SSR markup (empty), but the __seg-* children it gets filled with are JS-built. __panel--open + __row-value--empty are JS-toggled state modifiers.
cssStateElements.pa-range-group__panel--open: display:flex state on the __panel — range-group.js toggles it on open/close.
cssStateElements.pa-range-group__seg-label: JS-built summary segment (dimension name) injected into __summary when closed.
cssStateElements.pa-range-group__seg-value--empty: JS-built 'Any' placeholder segment when a dimension sits at its full bound.
cssStateElements.pa-range-group__row-value--empty: JS-toggled muted in-panel readout for an unbounded row.
